archetypes.name: bash-state
archetypes.rationale: New stall-recovery state mutators are shell-heavy and have nuanced atomic/KV failure semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new stall-recovery-report.sh state mutators, especially clear-stall and seed-terminal-state, for atomicity, bash portability, set -e behavior, and correct handling of absent, keyless, malformed, symlinked, and non-regular ship-pr-state.sh. Check whether emitted KVs reliably reflect success or failure and whether callers can safely interpret CLEARED and SEEDED without stale in-memory state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: final-report-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 17 and Step 18b final-summary emission moved into a wrapper with sentinel and failure-log integration risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 17 and Step 18b final-report handoff across SKILL.md, step-18b-final-report.sh, write-final-report.sh callsites, and related tests. Focus on summary-final.md emission decisions, .step17-emitted and .step17-printed sentinel ownership, failure-log side effects, token-report failure tolerance, and plugin-root or session-env rehydration. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: python-closes
archetypes.rationale: The Python PR-body refactor centralizes Closes footer logic and changes exact-match semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python PR body closes-line refactor in pr_body.py and tracking_issue.py. Check for import-cycle risk, regex and idempotency edge cases, footer-only semantics, interactions with Mermaid or prose mentions, and preservation of sanitize and redact fail-closed ordering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: Runtime prose, helper contracts, Makefile shards, agent-lint exclusions, and harness expectations changed together.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit whether the runtime skill prose, helper markdown contracts, Makefile targets, docs/linting entries, agent-lint exclusions, and structural harness assertions describe the same behavior. Pay special attention to drift between documented Step 18b emit rules and the actual shell wrapper implementation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
